claim_en: THE SUN IS A FIGURE AND THE BURGLAR CLAUSE SEEDS THE LIFE-OVERRIDE. R. Yishmael: 'did the sun rise on him alone?' — sunrise = PEACE-CLARITY (known at peace → killing liable); day/night explicitly not the divider (the betrothed-girl analogy: this verse comes to teach and ends up taught); from the tunneler's doubt-license the chain derives that saving life overrides — pikuach nefesh seeded in this clause. Onkelos renders the sun as THE EYE OF WITNESSES. Sold-for-theft capped six years from Exod 21:2.

check.note: A translation and a midrash independently replacing the sun with legal clarity; the life-override derived from the doubt-license.

claim_en: THE TOOTH CATEGORY AND THE DOMAIN MATRIX. 'The tooth is muad to eat what suits it, the beast to break as it walks'; liability from leaving the owner's domain; best-land assessment disputed (R. Yishmael: the victim's best; R. Akiva: the general assessment rule, a-fortiori to hekdesh); the FOUR GENERAL RULES (R. Shimon b. Elazar in R. Meir's name): the whose-domain matrix deciding exempt/full/half.

check.note: A damage category installed with its jurisdictional matrix.

claim_en: THE FIRE VERSE LEVELS THREE DISTINCTIONS: accident like intent, unintending like intending, THE WOMAN LIKE THE MAN for all the Torah's damages. The thorns give the measure (river/road/ten-hand fence; the cubit table); hidden vessels excluded (the field teaches the open only); the leaping-Jordan case.

check.note: Three equalizations derived from one seemingly redundant liability verse.

claim_en: THE COURT DERIVED FROM ITS OWN TOKENS. Elohim = the JUDGES (Onkelos: dayanaya at every token; the oracle excluded from 'asher yarshi'un'); MONETARY CASES IN THREE from the passage's three elohim-tokens (R. Yoshiyah / R. Yonatan / Rebbi, each with his counting method); 'ki hu zeh' = admission in part (the partial-admission oath's seed); 'every matter of trespass' run as general-particular-general → movables; Beit Shammai vs Beit Hillel on intent-of-misuse; double payment to the fellow, not to hekdesh.

check.note: Court size, judicial identity, and the admission-oath all read off one deposit passage.

claim_en: ALL TORAH OATHS BY THE NAME, FROM HERE. 'The oath of the LORD' specifies what every other oath-verse leaves plain — so all are by the Name; 'between the two of them' excludes heirs, the suspected opponent, and the judge's compulsion (R. Natan: the oath falls on both); 'the owner accepts and he shall not pay' — ALL WHO SWEAR BY TORAH LAW SWEAR AND DO NOT PAY; the carcass belongs to its owner; the preventable/overpowering predator table (cat, fox, marten pay; wolf, lion, bear, leopard, bardelas, snake exempt).

check.note: The Torah-wide oath default and the swear-not-pay rule wired to this unit.

claim_en: THE FOUR-KEEPERS TABLE CLOSES. The borrower detached into his own passage (nitko ha-katuv); liability from leaving the lender's domain; owner-with-him exempts even for one hour at the start; the HIRER derived from 'it came for its hire' — swears on accidents, pays theft and loss like the paid keeper. With 22:6-8 (unpaid) and 22:9-12 (paid — 'this one is the paid keeper, the earlier the unpaid'), the four-keeper architecture stands complete on this unit's ink.

check.note: The Mishnah's four-keepers table present as this chapter's own architecture.

claim_en: MOHAR = THE KETUBAH, WITH GENESIS AS THE LEXICON. 'Ein mohar ela ketubah,' proven from Shechem's 'multiply upon me mohar and gift' (Gen 34:12 — the derived gen_56 span's ink cited as the word's seat); the fine fixed at fifty by the not-betrothed gezerah shavah with the rapist's passage (run both directions); the father's veto; the no-father case included; 'fit to him as a wife' excludes forbidden unions.

check.note: A marriage-law institution defined on this verse with a Genesis narrative as its dictionary.

claim_en: THE TORN FLESH IN THE NOAHIDE BAN'S VOCABULARY, AND THE DOG'S WAGE. Onkelos renders 'flesh in the field, terefah' as FLESH TORN FROM THE LIVING ANIMAL — the Israel-side statute in the terms of Gen 9:4's limb ban (the two-era architecture of gen_21 visible in the received translation); 'in the field' = the ordinary case (dibber ha-katuv ba-hoveh, the method named on three parallels); benefit permitted — to the dog as-the-dog, the dog's Exodus-11 wage: 'the Holy One withholds no creature's reward'; holiness clauses (when-holy-Mine; every command adds holiness).

check.note: A cross-era vocabulary echo carried by the translation itself, plus the reward principle.

THE BURGLAR FILE'S BABYLONIAN LAYER. The hostility default set by KINSHIP (the two sun-baraitot resolve at the father — mercy presumed, kill only on certainty; anyone else, doubt kills); the license is a STATE not a status (both clauses on Shabbat, and the wall that falls ON him obligates rescue — Rav Sheshet); the pursuer status ('smitten' by ANY person; 'dies' by any death, needed because murderer + blood-redeemer are two-verses-as-one — the meta-rule named); the location extension (roof, courtyard, enclosure) with the seal HIS BREAKING IN IS HIS FOREWARNING. THE OATH'S ADMINISTRATION AND SUBJECT SCOPE. The oath rides THE COURT'S UNDERSTANDING (the reed of Rava's court the recorded exploit); the keeper's oath and the double payment both run generalization-detail-generalization to MOVABLES WITH INTRINSIC VALUE — land, Canaanite slaves, documents, consecrated property carved out; no oath on a minor's claim ('if a MAN delivers'); oaths only on amounts defined by size, weight, or number. Both-parties and not-the-heirs were ANTICIPATED at EX22-05's Mekhilta layer — the Babylonian rows credited to it. Filed F-056, auto-seated.

The sacrifices clause: to-the-gods bars the outside-slaughter reading; save-to-the-LORD-alone EMPTIES all inside-services to the Unique Name (the paradigm EX22-09's zevichah row carried); the hugger and kisser excluded by the sacrifice-verb; the blemished animal exempt (inside-style only); and the joining ban — the Name shared with another uproots.
